title: Intelligent electrochromic photothermal regulation for integrated building energy saving
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02750K, Paper
Yilin Ding, Zheyue Mei, Wenjing Zhang, Xueke Wu, Yaqi Zhang, Di Gao, Fan Lan, Run Li, Xungang Diao, Rufan Zhang
We have successfully designed a multi-band smart windows and selective dynamic radiative cooling regulators specifically tailored for both transparent and opaque building structures, resulting in comprehensive energy savings across building systems.
